decisions.reason: Premium support remains close to existing service capabilities and inexpensive to retain, so its option value justifies keeping it open despite limited visibility.
The legal-tool product is distant from the core, has shown no visible traction since 2019, and the firm has closer options, so its value is unlikely to justify further commitment.
Scalable hosting for agencies is the flagship and closely aligned with the firm's strategic direction, so it would be dropped only under strong negative evidence.
